an10.80:1.1: LXXX. Dasa yime bhikkhave āghātapaṭivinayā. Katame dasa? ‘Anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut 'ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘anatthaṃ me carati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘anatthaṃ me carissati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari . . . anatthaṃ carati . . . anatthaṃ carissati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari . . . atthaṃ carati . . . atthaṃ carissati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, aṭṭhāne ca na kuppati. Ime kho bhikkhave dasa āghātapaṭivinayā ti. Ākaṅkhavaggo aṭṭhamo.
an10.80:2.0: Tatr' uddānaṃ: Ākaṅkho kaṇṭako iṭṭhā vaḍḍhī ca Migasālaya Abhabbo c' eva kāko ca Nigaṇṭhā dve ca vatthunī
